input.unsupported: This browser has no Web MIDI
home.title: Read sheet music by playing your piano
home.lead: Connect a piano or keyboard over USB-MIDI and practise note reading, key signatures and your own repertoire. No MIDI? Use the on-screen keyboard, your computer keyboard or the microphone.
home.testHint: Play any key on your piano: it should show up here.
home.notes.desc: Single notes on treble and bass clef, with as many ledger lines as you want.
home.keys.desc: Recognise key signatures at a glance, with spaced repetition.
home.sight.desc: Short fragments generated on the fly to read unprepared.
home.library.desc: Your scores in MusicXML or PDF. The cursor moves on when you play the right notes.
home.stats.desc: Which notes and key signatures really trip you up.
home.kbdHint: Computer keyboard: A W S E D F T G Y H U J K = C to C. Z and X change octave.
home.browserNote: Web MIDI works in desktop Chrome, Edge, Opera and Firefox, and in Chrome for Android over an OTG cable. Safari and iOS do not support it: use the microphone there.
settings.title: Settings
settings.namingHint: In the German system, H is B natural and B is B flat.
settings.soundOnScreen: Sound when playing on screen or with the computer keyboard
settings.soundOnMidi: Sound for MIDI input too (if your keyboard is silent)
settings.showNoteNames: Show note names on the on-screen keyboard
settings.libraryHint: URL of a doremifaaa server with your repertoire. Leave empty to use the server hosting the app, if it has one.
settings.serverTokenHint: Only needed if the server sets WRITE_TOKEN. Stays on this device.
sync.title: Server
sync.profileHint: Devices with the same profile share settings and progress. Letters, numbers, - and _.
sync.off: Not syncing: no server with a store at this address. Everything stays in this browser.
sync.copied: Copied. Open it on another device to connect it.
keys.title: Key signatures
keys.lead: Name the key: tap the button or play the tonic on the piano. The ones you struggle with come back sooner.
keys.hint.sharps: Tip: the last sharp ({note}) is the leading note; the tonic is a semitone above.
keys.hint.flats: Tip: the second to last flat ({note}) is the tonic.
keys.hint.oneFlat: Tip: a single flat ({note}) is {major} major, just memorise it.
keys.hint.minor: The relative minor is a minor third (3 semitones) below the major.
library.title: Repertoire
library.lead: MusicXML scores (.musicxml, .xml or .mxl) to play with following: the cursor moves on when you are right. PDFs can be read and turned with the pedal.
library.serverHint.one: {n} piece from {name}. It updates by itself when the vault notes change.
library.serverHint.other: {n} pieces from {name}. It updates by itself when the vault notes change.
library.noLocal: You have not added any yet.
library.samplesHint: Public domain melodies with a simple two-hand arrangement.
library.where: Where do I get MusicXML? MuseScore exports it (File › Export). There are public domain scores on MuseScore.com, OpenScore or IMSLP, and Audiveris converts scanned PDFs.
library.selfhost: Keep your scores in Obsidian or on a server? doremifaaa ships a small Docker server that reads your notes and PDFs: see the project README.
manage.uploadHint: MusicXML, MXL or PDF, or drop files here. Each file becomes a piece you can edit.
manage.vaultHint: This piece comes from the Obsidian vault and is read-only here.
manage.title: Title
manage.originalHint: The version kept before the score was replaced.
manage.wrongKind: {name} is not the right kind of file for this slot.
manage.deleteHint: Removes the piece and its files from the server. It cannot be undone.
manage.error.token: The server needs a write token. Set it in Settings. ({message})
manage.error.origin: The server does not accept changes from this address. Add it to ALLOWED_ORIGINS. ({message})
manage.error.tooLarge: The file is too large for the server. ({message})
manage.error.unsupported: The server only accepts MusicXML, MXL or PDF. ({message})
manage.error.server: The server answered with an error. ({message})
import.title: Import from the vault
import.plan.one: {n} of {total} vault pieces is not in the store yet ({done} already imported).
import.plan.other: {n} of {total} vault pieces are not in the store yet ({done} already imported).
import.incomplete.one: {n} imported piece is missing a file that the vault has.
import.incomplete.other: {n} imported pieces are missing files that the vault has.
import.readOnly: Scores, PDFs and metadata are copied. The vault notes are not changed.
omr.badgeHint: Measures whose notes do not add up to the time signature or with an empty staff: {list}
omr.notice.one: This score may have mistakes: {n} of {total} measures does not add up to the time signature or has an empty staff ({list}).
omr.notice.other: This score may have mistakes: {n} of {total} measures do not add up to the time signature or have an empty staff ({list}).
omr.noticeConverted.one: Converted automatically from the PDF. {n} of {total} measures looks wrong ({list}): compare it with the PDF.
omr.noticeConverted.other: Converted automatically from the PDF. {n} of {total} measures look wrong ({list}): compare them with the PDF.
notes.title: Note reading
notes.lead: A note appears on the staff: play it. The ones you miss or read slowly come back more often.
notes.noMisses: None. Raise the difficulty whenever you like.
pdf.pedalHint: Sustain pedal, arrows, Page Down or space: scroll down one screen. Arrow up or Page Up: scroll up.
pdf.noFollow: PDFs have no note following: that needs the score in MusicXML.
piece.notFound: Could not find “{id}” in your repertoire.
player.notFound: This score is no longer available. Go back to the repertoire and open it again.
player.hint: Show the notes to play on the keyboard
sight.title: Sight-reading
sight.lead: A new fragment every time, impossible to memorise. In wait mode the cursor moves on when you are right; in tempo mode it follows the metronome and does not wait.
sight.level.1: Steps and small leaps, halves and quarters
sight.level.3: Eighths, fifths and one ledger line
sight.level.4: Leaps of a sixth and two ledger lines
stats.title: Progress
stats.lead: Everything is stored in this browser. You can export it from Settings.
stats.empty: No data yet. Do a notes or key signature session and come back.
stats.heatLegend: Redder means more misses. Uncoloured keys have not been asked yet.
stats.keysLegend: Green: mastered (answered fast several times). Red: you often miss it.
stats.noWeak: Nothing stands out: either there is not enough data or you master it all.
